d: Manchester United keep changing managers and somehow the results and the chaos stay exactly the same, and Michael Carrick is just the latest casualty of a club that's still searching for answers more than a decade after Sir Alex Ferguson left, and Mauricio Pochettino could be next in line, but with all the questions around the Manchester United hierarchy, transfer policy, football structure and decision-making, the bigger job might actually be fixing the club itself, so Rupha Ramani looks at the Old Trafford revolving door, Pochettino's potential appointment, and why this managerial…
